notes.title: The official version 1.0 of "That That" is now playable
notes.notes:
Hi cowboys,
It's nice to tell everyone that the official version 1.0 of "That That" is now playable. After discussing with part of players, we decided to keep the ranking score on the EA stage. 
The mainly new mode in this version is Lord Mode. Here is an introduction of this mode:

Lord Mode is a mode inspired by M&B, which allows players to recruit their army on a big map and capture the town. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33429835/c12e51e601cc22d9f68297bf99da5c5494b741ef.png[/img]

Simple economy system: Players can trade goods to get enough money to maintain the army.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33429835/fc6b78e3e65aa31960df5ca59a38fd3903cb5a57.png[/img]

Skill system: Get exp from battles and upgrade the skills, including moving speed, expanding the army scale, etc.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33429835/64dfff2b919fbc2fcae1b720a3b00cc7d68849de.png[/img]

Army upgrade tree: Player can improve the "training" level to gain training points for the army.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33429835/7d095c7682bc078745f4037be08e864717e7ba24.png[/img]

Here is a brief introduction to Lord Mode. If you would like to more about this mode, you can check the guide in the community.  Lord Mode is a brand new mode, also the first time I try to create this game mode, so there might be some function missing, and balance issues need fix. I'd like to hear your feedback and improve it.

Besides Lord Mode, you can see we also add something else to launching the official version. Such as new mini-games, new character-changing functions, etc.

At last, I'd like to say thank you so much for all the players support this game, especially your tolerance and understanding for the early version.
It's your support that made this immature game not give up but stick to the release of the official version.

notes.title: Automatic rifle? Vote for game develop decision
notes.notes:
Greetings cowboys,

In the lowpoly version, I added automatic rifle into the game which is not invented yet back to 1800s. Because in my opinion the game should mainly focus on having fun. I prefer to provide more weapon genre instead of been restricted by history.

However, according to the feedback, I realized not all players seem be happy about this. One negative review point out: "the gun selection is bizarre and anachronistic." 

Since the new DLC is the "realistic" version, should I keep the gun selection been realistic too? Or add the automatic rifle so there will have more weapon genre. I'd like to hear your thought and make this decision by the result of this survey.

Vote Link:
https://forms.gle/xwdsbjPSHGyGo8E8A

notes.title: About new upcoming update and realistic version
notes.notes:
Hello Cowboys,

It's been a while since last blog posted. I was planning to update the game by the end of April, however, making the realistic version really cost me more unexpected times due to lack of experience of unreal engine 4.

Today I'm going to intro the upcoming content and future plan about this game. 

[b]About new update:[/b]
The next update v0.3 will be playable on the next week. This update is mainly focus on content fill for existing mode, especially for [b]Story Mode[/b]. There is no new mode on this update but will have new maps for each mode and new mini-game. so, whether which mode you like, you will find new contents there. 
I will post another blog about detail for the update once it's online.

[b]When will the realistic version playable:[/b]
And for those people who waiting for realistic version, I'm glad to tell you the first version will release very soon. (within this month).
I have finished all the basic parts such as controller and AI, and some features like dynamic sky which make the game looks even better. I'm now looking for some decent character models and impact particles to replace the demo ones. Once the art asset replacements are finished, I will run a quick test to make sure it plays smoothly for the most current-gen graphic card.

[b]How to play realistic version[/b]
The realistic version will come as a [b]Free [/b]DLC. The reason why I do this is mainly because this version would cost much more space for the hard-drive. So if it comes as a DLC, you can easily choose whether install it or not instead of install bunch of content anyway. Also the hardware requirement is different. I will do my best try to optimize it, but still you cannot expect some very old graphic card can run the current-gen environment. 


That's all I got today. As always, if you have any question or suggestion, please leave a reply in the comments section. The discussion boards are also welcome.
Wish you best and good luck.

notes.title: Update Beta v0.2.1.0 is now live!(Mar. 11)
notes.notes:
Hello Cowboys,
The new big update is coming, I'm working on the final testing to make sure there is no crucial bug. (Update: It' will be playable on March 11th with 33% weeklong discount).

Quick Mode:
Two new maps
One for native American style, one for forest camp.
The feature of these two maps is they both lack of big cover, so they are harder.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/26ca66e7fb4dfccd2be02f6ee96199dd60dffc32.jpg[/img]

Mini-games Mode:
New west duel game.
This game is mainly inspired by the old NES(FC) game “Wild Gunman”. Player need to fellow the west duel rule and try to win a glorious victory.
(and thanks to players who suggest me add this mini-game)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/18c3190327d93b1f68a8e30b7c02fd95b0f32063.jpg[/img]

New mode:
Endless mode. A brand-new mode contains items dropping system which is also main content for this update. There is more detail intro about this mode later in this blog. 

Function improvements:
1. Custom key binding system. Now player can freely bind their own keys on the setting panel.
2. Auto/Hand Take cover option. According players’ feedback, players now can choose whether automatically taking cover or not. The default will still be “auto”. If you switch to by hand then the default button is key “C”, also you can adjust your own prefer key.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/37c678120c028ef5a6784df6a81237dde8ef2566.jpg[/img]


Next is the detail introduction about the new Endless Mode: 
Gameplay:
In this mode, you play the game in a much bigger map than other mode. In the beginning, the map will generate some fighting areas. Once you step into that area, a new fighting start. The endless mode provides a new fighting gameplay: Dropping items, no health regeneration, limited bullets. Fighting areas will keep refresh until the player dead or chose to leave.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/3b5de81932d82b321652da19ec23b3db3f83ba0e.jpg[/img]

Items:
Here are 4 items for now, I will keep add more in the future.
1.Heath
Add 30% heath once picked up.
2.Bullets
All weapons get a magazine of bullets
3.Accurate
Player get 300% speed for a while.
4. Shield
Players gain 5 seconds of invincibility
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/33fb681e5b7b4f7c9fd71160d3681719eea6d6bd.jpg[/img]

Other function:
Riding system
Long press “E” to ride the horse, and also long press “E” to leave.
Leaderboard
The mode will have an independent steam leaderboard, but your upgrades in the camp will still be applied in this mode. 

The new mode has just been finished, and there may be some serious bugs. If you meet any problems, please feel free to let me know. I’ll fix it as soon as possible.

I know someone is waiting for the realistic style version. I have finished the player controller part for that version. Still lots works need to do, such as AI. Hope I can release the first demo for realistic version by the end of next month. I will let you guys know the developing progress.

notes.title: Big decision: The game will support the current-gen realistic style in the future
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/6bda3e9917a237d9daeae3a2ab98317653cd1d34.jpg[/img]
Hi cowboys,
The endless mode is not online yet, but there is a reason!
When I was learning the Unreal Engine last week, I accidentally saw a very high quality Western environmental pack. The quality is too good, I just can't help but immediately buy it. After trying to rebuild the scenes in the game with these models, I was shocked by the result, it's just too beautiful!!!

After that, I made this decision: The game should have a version with this style! 
Don't get me wrong, I don't mean to replace all the current version contents directly but add a new realistic version. The game will have a launcher. You can choose the style you like to play.

Here's a comparison of the two styles:
lowpoly screenshot:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/24c4b4d9bcad864606cab2f2ab0cb3880604b3c4.jpg[/img]

realistic screenshot:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/98f79a7a84f9fa082835cb684e6a6e2a4078a639.jpg[/img]

Of course, because this new version needs to build in the new engine, the previously implemented functions need to be reworked. In addition to the scene, the game also needs character models, weapons and so on to be made. So, it still needs time to develop. My plan is to launch the first beta version of the new style within two months, then fill the existing content of the original version in to new one.
At the same time, the cartoon version content update will continue, endless mode because this has been delayed for a while, will be online as soon as possible.

Hope you guys are happy with this plan. If you have any question or suggestion, please leave a reply in the comments section. The discussion boards are also welcome.
Wish you best and good luck.

notes.title: Happy new year! Upcoming new mode intro
notes.notes:
Hi cowboys,
Wish you all have a great new year.
Today I'm going to introduce the upcoming new mode: Endless Mode
(or Sandbox Mode, I haven't decided the name yet)

In this mode, you play the game in a much bigger map than other mode. It contains few towns.
In the beginning, the map will randomly generate some fighting areas. Once you step into that area, a new fighting start. After you cleaned some areas, the system will create more new area to fill the map.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/3b5de81932d82b321652da19ec23b3db3f83ba0e.jpg[/img]

See that blue circle there, it is a fighting area.
Also, since this map is much bigger than the other mode. You don't want to waste time on running the map. As you might have noticed, I add the rider system into this mode.
(How could a wild west game without riding)
Ps: you can only ride the horse for running the map for now, the rider fighting system has not been added yet. 

Unlike other mode, this mode you don't have infinite bullets. The enemies will drop them and also other items. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/33fb681e5b7b4f7c9fd71160d3681719eea6d6bd.jpg[/img]

You can easily tell what these items are. For example, in this mode you will not be able to regenerate automatically, you need to collect health item to regain the health. 
The mode will have an independent steam leaderboard, but your upgrades in the camp will still be applied in this mode. 

That's it. Hope you will like this new mode. It should be able to play within two weeks. Also, more levels and maps will be added into Quick Mode and Story Mode in the future update.

If you have any question or suggestion, please leave a reply in the comments section. The discussion boards are also welcome.
Again, I really appreciate your playing and interests for my game. Wish you best and good luck.

notes.title: Update Info Beta v0.1.1.8
notes.notes:
Hi cowboys,

After receiving two days of feedback, I fixed and adjusted some of the features.
This update is mainly to fix the existing problems and adjust the balance of the game. 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Adjustment:

Weapon: (The main adjustment goal is to make each gun useful, instead of sniper world)
Increase pistol damage
Increase Thompson damage
Reduce the recoil of the Thompson
Increase shotgun damage
Reduce shotgun shooting range
Reduce sniper damage

Other:
Increase player health recovery speed
Adjust the quick mode start animation speed
Reduce shooting bullet sound in the quick mode
Raise the price of snipers in bounty hunters
Significantly reduce the enemy's time to track players, now as long as you hide well, some of the enemy will give up looking for you.
Adjust part of the map terrain
Add a description of the grenade in the tutorial
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
The following issues have been fixed:

After completing the game and uploading the score, player can restart by not cost the bounty hunter again.
The cursor occasionally hides after the game is over
After the player dies, the bounty hunter kills the enemy and still shows victory.
Some walls and doors don't have collision
The window changes back to the full screen when start a game.
Choosing a enter point in the quick mode sometimes get stuck.
Bullet shot particle display does not correspond to actual shooting effect
The 2nd level of story mode don't have sniper scope.
Part of the maps computer path finding out of range
Quick mode setting difficulty and wave, etc. directly return to the scene, resulting in no data reset
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
New Content Added:

Increase the ally outline, now the friendly will display a green outline to facilitate identification of the enemy
Quick mode adds a reset button
Add end animation for 2nd level of story mode
Increase the automatic pop-up function of the tutorial, the first time you run the game will pop up the tutorial
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This update has not yet implemented all feedback, and some of the feedback added to the plan will be implemented in the next update. More new content will be added in the next update.
Please feel free to contact me if you have any questions or suggestions.
Thanks to all the players who gave feedback and suggestions for these two days! You made this game better.

Again, I really appreciate your interest for my game. Wish you best and good luck.

notes.title: Game mode intro: Story mode
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/c775daa634be4532a2d73cfe77bf8f144f43de92.png[/img]
Hello cowboys,
It's time to introduce the story mode. As the name implies, this mode contains a little storytelling. I'm not a fan of movie-like storytelling and writing dialogue also is not what I'm good at. So how can I make the storytelling in a simply but nice way? 

I got the idea from some Nintendo games. When I played Pokémon, the NPC would pop out an exclamation point to notice me they need help, the question mark pops out would means they might have some questions. In this way, I try to make the story with simple icons plus animation. Hope the result would satisfy you. The story would not take your long time, after all, easy and simple is the core style of the game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/6828042f997b8b87cfae4b4841f43ac324558376.png[/img]

After sharing the telling style. Let me intro our boss: Cooper brothers. The older brother runs a cigar company, the younger runs a mining business. Both are arrogant and domineering, hire people run amok in the area. You need to defeat both brothers and destroy their dens. If you like to know more stories, welcome to the game and try it.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/64bf5b3b1582626cf8e2b06fae142c6f743b0a65.png[/img]


The two portraits above are theirs. On the EA stage, I have finished 1/3 story contents. You can tell from the story road map.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/0f5b229a271b27ca4b040f7dcccdde6b4ec4798c.png[/img]

Overall, I make this mode to fill more playable contents in the game, so if you tired about quick mode, maybe you can try this one. Next time I will talk about the mini-games. 

Hope you enjoyed this blog. If you have any question or suggestion, please leave a reply in the comments section. The discussion boards are also welcome.

notes.title: Game mode intro: Quick Mode
notes.notes:
Greetings cowboys,
Starting from today, I will post some dev blogs to introduce contents of the game and what I have added recently.
For now, the game has three modes: Quick mode, Story mode and the mini-games mode. First please let me intro the quick mode.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/2c44d22b0cdaf10bc5171bbfb5b049804df9d6cd.png[/img]
As I said in the store page, the inspiration for making the "Take That" is I want to play a shooting game without so many complicated processes or storytelling. Some online shooting games such as CS don't have such things, but pvp sometimes can be very frustrating. 
Here comes out this quick mode fit my goal.

[h1]Features of quick mode[/h1][list]
[*] It can be started within seconds
[*] Three difficulties for each map
[*] Maximum 5 extra waves 
[*] Three enter-points can be chosen
[*] Hire bounty hunters to help you
[/list]

For each enter-point, you can arrange up to three bounty hunters. 
After earning some rewards, you can go to camps to hire them. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/031fa438db677efe6af1187a03e2531f560dfec2.png[/img]
They use different types of weapon and have different characteristics. 
If you just need someone to attract attention and block the bullet for you, the gambler would be a nice choice. If you need a real shooter, hire the snipers, they are very deadly. 
(price for hiring each type could be changed, the balance is still in testing)

You might notice there is also an Upgrade button in the screenshot, basically, it's another place you can spend your money on camps, you can upgrade some basic abilities there. I will intro more detail about that in the feature.

Overall, I try to make this mode can be started very quickly, but also interesting. Next time I will talk about the story mode. 
Hope you enjoyed this blog. If you have any question or suggestion, please leave a reply in the comments section. The discussion boards are also welcome.

notes.title: About the game release delay
notes.notes:
Thanks for your interest in this game.

Since opening the store page in August, I have tried to polish the game over the past two months. Although it has been going well so far, when I try to play my game with a truly player’s mindset, I find that the game really lacks playable content. (although adding mini-games can barely fill the content)

In the beginning, I just want to make a shooting game can be play at any time. But think about it, if there is nothing more than just shooting, then dose my game has a similar cool feeling like “DOOM”? Of course not.

Further thinking, although several levels have been created, there is no any different between each level expect terrain and buildings.  

I was still hesitant. I felt that although there was not much content, after all, it was the EA stage. I can continue to develop after the game release. Recently a brother’s message helps me made decision. “games like this are dying quickly. I've played around 2/3 games that were looking the same as this game and they died in less than 1/2 weeks.”

I decided to postpone the game's release time. During this time, I will add more content to the game and adjusted the levels so that each level has its own characteristics and make sure there are more playable content before it is released.
In the future, I will also post articles to introduce the playable content of the game.

Thanks for your interest again.
